jobs.title: Software Developer / Ontwikkelaar – C#/.NET & Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
jobs.description:
**Ontwikkelaar Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central**

**32 – 40 uur per week \| Salaris vanaf € 4\.500 per maand \| HBO/WO**

Ben jij een ontwikkelaar die graag verder kijkt dan alleen code? Bij **Addition Solutions** combineer je jouw technische kennis met inzicht in bedrijfsprocessen. Je werkt aan innovatieve softwareoplossingen voor onze klanten en ontwikkelt functionaliteiten binnen **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central** én onze eigen applicaties.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen met developers en consultants bouw je aan slimme, schaalbare oplossingen die iedere dag door onze klanten worden gebruikt.

**Wat ga je doen?**

Als Ontwikkelaar ben je betrokken bij de volledige ontwikkeling van onze oplossingen. Je denkt mee over vraagstukken, maakt technische keuzes en zorgt ervoor dat functionaliteiten betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig worden gerealiseerd.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

* Analyseren van functionele vraagstukken en deze vertalen naar een technisch ontwerp.
* Ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (AL)**.
* Doorontwikkelen en verbeteren van onze eigen applicaties en integraties.
* Werken met **C\#/.NET en JavaScript**.
* Uitvoeren van technische optimalisaties gericht op stabiliteit, performance en gebruiksgemak.
* Testen van je eigen ontwikkelingen en ondersteunen bij integratie\- en acceptatietests.
* Meewerken aan uiteenlopende klantprojecten.
* Meedenken over nieuwe mogelijkheden, technische verbeteringen en innovaties.
* Bijhouden van ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied en delen van kennis met collega's.

**Wie zoeken wij?**

We zoeken een ontwikkelaar die het leuk vindt om techniek te combineren met het oplossen van bedrijfsvraagstukken. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking met collega's.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

* HBO/WO werk\- en denkniveau.
* Kennis van **C\#/.NET**.
* Kennis van **AL** en/of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
* Kennis van **JavaScript**.
* Een zelfstandige en proactieve werkhouding.
* De motivatie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Heb je nog niet met alle genoemde technieken gewerkt, maar beschik je wel over een goede technische basis en leer je snel? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

**Wat bieden wij jou?**

Bij Addition Solutions krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je kunt rekenen op:

* Een zelfstandige functie met veel **autonomie en verantwoordelijkheid**.
* Een salarisindicatie vanaf **€ 4\.500 per maand**, afhankelijk van ervaring en vaardigheden.
* Junior ontwikkelaars kunnen naar dit salaris toegroeien; ervaren/senior ontwikkelaars kunnen meer verdienen.
* Een jaarlijkse **bonusregeling**.
* Een persoonlijk **opleidingsplan**, afgestemd op jouw ambities.
* Een laptop van de zaak.
* Een telefoonvergoeding.
* Directe impact op projecten en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief.
* Een enthousiast en betrokken team.
* Korte lijnen en een informele, professionele werksfeer.
* Een fulltime functie van **32 tot 40 uur per week**.

**Werken bij Addition Solutions**

Addition Solutions heeft meer dan 20 jaar ervaring met de uitvoering van IT\-projecten. We implementeren **Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central** en ontwikkelen daarnaast onze eigen tools waarmee klanten hun bedrijfsspecifieke processen flexibel kunnen configureren.

Daarmee bieden we onze klanten de flexibiliteit die ze nodig hebben, zonder de complexiteit van traditioneel maatwerk. Onze oplossingen sluiten aan op de nieuwste programmatuur en kunnen met de organisatie meegroeien.

We zijn een compacte organisatie met korte lijnen. Geen logge structuren of lange besluitvormingstrajecten, maar een team van professionals dat samenwerkt aan slimme en duurzame oplossingen.

Als ontwikkelaar krijg je bij ons niet alleen de opdracht om iets te bouwen, maar ook de mogelijkheid om **mee te denken over hoe het beter kan**.

**Interesse?**

Wil jij als ontwikkelaar werken aan uitdagende softwareoplossingen, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central en eigen applicaties? En spreekt een zelfstandige rol binnen een compact en professioneel team je aan?

**Dan maken we graag kennis met je.**

Stuur je CV en motivatie naar **chiel@additionsolutions.nu**.

Heb je eerst nog vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met **Chiel Gortemaker via 0541\-760040**.

Salaris: €2\.800,00 \- €5\.500,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Bedrijfsfeesten

Samen met een hecht team van professionals werk je aan HRControlNet: onze krachtige SaaS\-oplossing die dagelijks impact maakt bij grote Nederlandse werkgevers. Als Senior .NET Developer ben jij de architect én bouwer van onze software. Je leidt de ontwikkeling van nieuwe features, optimaliseert onze softwarearchitectuur en zorgt voor een veilige, stabiele en toekomstbestendige codebase.

jobs.title: Partner Success Manager (DACH) (CPM/EPM Software)
jobs.description:
**Partner Success Manager (DACH)**

  


**Location:** Remote, Germany or Remote, Switzerland


**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


**Benefits Offered:** Vision, Medical, Life, Dental, 401K


**Gross annual base salary:** Germany: EUR 75,000 \- 97,500,


Switzerland CHF 114,000 \- 148,000


*Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply. Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job\-related criteria.*

  


**Summary**



As a Partner Success Manager (PSM), this role will play a critical role in driving the success of the OneStream partner ecosystem. The role is responsible for developing, supporting and growing all skillsets within a portfolio of strategic partners. This role blends relationship management, enablement strategy, and operational excellence to help partners build a scalable, high performing and self\-sufficient practice.



The Partner Success position bridges the gap between OneStream’s internal teams—such as customer success, partner alliances and partner enablement—and its partners, managing the functional and technical aspects of partner implementations, making sure partner needs are addressed promptly and thoroughly, and fostering lasting relationships to enhance the partner experience. This includes project tracking, partner health and growth, partner program tier levelling, measurement through scorecards, OnePass utilization and ensuring skill level certifications. Orchestrating engagements centrally with project involvement will strengthen the understanding of how and when to engage the wider Customer Support and Remote Consulting (CSRC) teams and provide opportunities for enablement/training of our partners.

  


**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**


**Partner Relationship \& Support**


* Act as the primary point of contact for implementation partners, ensuring the partner has the necessary resources and both technical and functional support.
* Own regular partner status calls to discuss partner project delivery status and delivery concerns.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with partners to drive success of OneStream implementations and partner success.
* Provide guidance on overall partner health and future planning with the partner.
* Serve as a co\-liaison with Partner Alliances between partners and internal teams (Support, Remote Consulting, Partner Enablement, Engineering, Customer Success), focusing on creating value for the partner by guiding them to appropriate teams and processes when needed.
* Alert Partner Alliances and other internal leadership concerns related to the delivery of project timelines mitigating risk.
* Provide input to Partner Delivery Managers on the leveling of partners based on experience working with specific implementation partners and their perceived skillsets.
* Maintain clear and concise communication with partners and internal stakeholders.
* Responsible for driving the partners to develop and maintain a COE function within their practices.

  


**Project Oversight \& Functional Support**


* Monitor and support partner led implementations to ensure adherence to project delivery and partner success.
* Review projects plans and provide recommendations to project timelines and go\-live success.
* Seek opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and adoption via Functional enablement to our partners. Recommend the use of enablement materials to partners based on customer requirements and expectations.
* Review partner cases and their nature to ensure they are utilizing their internal COE correctly.
* Review and identify key deliverables for partner success.

  


**Enablement**


* Develop and deliver partner Seismic pages with functional information, new features and solution content.
* Actively engage partners with COE with online (i.e.Navigator) courses, content and enablement materials.

  


**Process Improvement**


* Identify opportunities to improve partner processes and develop strategies to improve efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve proactive enablement and proactive services and develop strategies and new services to prevent customer escalations.
* Create SOP documentation on engaged projects and look to role this out further for governance on projects
* GAP analysis with alliances to help build a more robust framework for our partners for processes and active projects/project management.

  


**Required Education and Experience**


* Bachelor’s degree in fields such as (but not limited to) Accounting, Business, Finance, Information Systems, Mathematics, or CIS, or equivalent work experience.
* Minimum 2 years of experience with project management, stakeholder management, or account management.
* Minimum 5 years of experience consulting or Functional account management for software implementations for Corporate Performance Management / Enterprise Performance Management (CPM/EPM) platforms.
* Must Speak both Fluent German and English.

  


**Preferred Education and Experience**


* Prior experience within a Partner Success position.
* Master’s degree in business, Accounting, Finance, or Information Technology.
* A professional accounting designation (e.g. CPA, CMA, CGA, CA), advanced degrees (MBA, MFA), and/or other professional designations or certifications (applicable to accounting/finance and information technology)
* Project management, program management or account management expertise.
* Prior experience in Partner Success or Customer Success.
* Deep experience with SQL, C\#, VB.net, or Visual Basic. Any object\-oriented programing a plus.
* Prior experience and expertise in Scalability and Performance of EPM/CPM products.
* Prior experience with Azure based SaaS platforms.
* Prior experience using Telemetry tools to monitor EPM/CPM applications.
* Prior experience with any of the following products is a plus:
* + OneStream
	+ SAP Outlooksoft BPC or SAP BOFC (Cartesis)
	+ Hyperion Planning, Hyperion Essbase, Hyperion Financial Management (HFM)
	+ FDM (Financial Data Quality Management) or UpStream
	+ IBM Cognos
	+ Other CPM/EPM solutions. i.e. BlackLine, Trintech, Workiva, Tagetik, Board, Vena, Prophix, Lucanet, Jedox

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**


* Excellent project skills related to product implementation.
* Excellent customer service skills.
* An ability to effectively communicate concise functional guidance and recommendations.
* Ability to develop trust and strong relationships.
* Ability to deliver difficult feedback regarding product implementations and project status.
* Desire to enable others and continuously grow functional knowledge.
* Self\-directed and strong desire to succeed.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage and complete multiple streams of work in a timely manner.
* Presentation skills and strong interpersonal communication abilities.
* Ability to collaborate and solve problems alone and as a team.

jobs.description:
**Location:**  

Rosyth, Dunfermline, Kirkcaldy, GB, KY11 2YD
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }

**Salary:** Minimum £35,000\. Salary is dependent on location, role and qualifications.
  
  

**Location:** Rosyth, Fife, Scotland
  
  

**Application closing date:** 20 October 2026
  
  

**Programme start date:** September 2027
  
  

**Role ID:** 74560
  
  

What will you do on the programme?
  
  

At Babcock, Systems Engineering is the glue that holds complex projects together. As a Graduate Systems Engineer, you’ll be at the centre of some of the UK’s most advanced engineering programmes \- applying systems principles to ensure that every component, process and stakeholder aligns to deliver safe, effective and sustainable solutions.
  
  

Your work will shape systems that matter. You could be involved in designing and integrating cutting\-edge submarines, converting military vehicles for new operational roles, refurbishing naval ships to extend their service life, infrastructure to support the refit of nuclear submarines, developing secure satellite communication systems, or advancing next\-generation nuclear power plants that support the UK’s net\-zero goals. Each project presents unique systems challenges – and opportunities to make a real impact.
  
  

You’ll support work across various stages of the engineering lifecycle – from technology innovation and concept design to production, commissioning, in\-service support, and decommissioning. You’ll help bring structure to complexity \- defining requirements, managing interfaces and supporting integration across multidisciplinary teams. Through practical experience and structured development, you’ll build the skills to engage with stakeholders, understand system needs, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure systems meet requirements and are ready for the real world.
  
  

How is the programme structured?
  
  

Over two years, you’ll rotate through placements every three to six months, giving you the opportunity to explore a broad range of projects and teams. These rotations offer opportunities to broaden your experience – and some may even take you to different locations – helping you build your professional network and deepen your understanding of how the business operates.
  
  

Along the way, you’ll collaborate with experienced professionals across a range of disciplines, which may include engineering design, software, mechanical, construction, and electrical engineering, as well as in project management, quality assurance, and supply chain.
  
  

This experience will help you build a strong foundation in systems engineering, while gradually taking on greater responsibilities, such as leading small teams and overseeing projects. As you progress, you'll have the chance to align your placements with your interests and career goals, helping you build relevant experience in areas that matter most to you.
  
  

How do we develop and support you?
  
  

From day one, you’ll receive structured support, personalised training, and dedicated mentorship to help you excel throughout your programme and beyond.
  
  

You’ll join our Graduate Development Programme, featuring expert\-led masterclasses on communication, personal branding, resilience, and wellbeing.
  
  

To support your journey toward Chartered or Incorporated Engineer status, we offer guidance and cover all associated fees.
  
  

What’s waiting for you after the programme?
  
  

Once you complete the programme, you’ll move into a permanent role within our Engineering Function, where you can continue applying and expanding the skills you've developed. You’ll also have the opportunity to build on your progress toward professional registration, a recognised benchmark of engineering competence, which can support your journey into more advanced roles, such as Senior Engineer.
  
  

As a global organisation, Babcock provides countless opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. To support your growth, we've introduced the Babcock Role Framework, which outlines roles, career pathways, and development opportunities. With every job mapped to these frameworks, you’ll have a transparent view of the steps needed to reach Senior Engineer and beyond.
  
  

What rewards and benefits will you get?
  
  

We want you to feel supported, valued and excited about what’s ahead. That’s why we offer a comprehensive package designed to support your development, your wellbeing and your life outside of work too.
  
  

In addition to a minimum starting salary of £35,000, you’ll benefit from:
  
  

A minimum of 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays
  
Generous pension and employee share schemes
  
Flexible benefits, including cycle to work scheme, discounts
  
Wellbeing support, covering mental, physical, financial, and social wellbeing, with services like our Employee Assistance Programme, digital GP service, and health checks.
  
  

You’ll also have the chance to get involved in our STEM outreach activities and volunteering opportunities.
  
  

What do you need to apply?
  
  

You'll need to have achieved, or be on track to achieve, a BEng, MEng, BSc, or MSc in a STEM discipline. We welcome applicants from a broad range of subjects, including Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and emerging technology fields such as AI, Machine Learning, Robotics, and Cybernetics.
  
Many of our programmes are subject to Security Clearance and Trade Control restrictions which mean that your place of birth, nationality, citizenship, or residency you hold or have held may impact which programmes you are eligible for. For this programme, you must be able to achieve and maintain Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and Security Check (SC) security clearance. For further details, visit GOV.UK and search ‘United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels’.
  
  

Where will you be based?
  
  

Places on our Systems Engineering programme for September 2027 are available in Rosyth, Scotland.
  
  

Our 320\-acre Rosyth facility is home to one of the UK’s largest and most advanced waterside manufacturing and repair sites. As a graduate, you could be involved in supporting the full lifecycle of naval vessels or helping deliver complex, large\-scale marine build projects. Whether you're working on new\-build programmes or enhancing existing systems, your role will be vital in delivering dependable, mission\-ready solutions across the marine industry.
  
  

We offer agile working, giving you some flexibility, but you can expect to spend several days a week on\-site as part of your role and development. By your start date, you must be able to reliably commute to the site. This will normally require living within a reasonable commuting distance of Rosyth or relocating before you join us.
  
  

While you’ll join a specific business area and location, placements at different sites across the UK are possible. We encourage flexibility and openness to relocation throughout the programme and will consider your personal circumstances when arranging placements.
  
  

Application process and important information
  
  

Applications are reviewed in the order they are received, and if there’s a high level of interest in this programme, we may close applications earlier than advertised. To give yourself the best chance of being considered, we recommend submitting your application and completing any required online assessments as soon as possible.
  
  

Please apply to one programme only. If we receive more than one application from you, we’ll assess the first one submitted. If your chosen programme becomes oversubscribed, we may contact you to discuss other programmes you could be eligible for.
  
  

We're a Disability Confident Employer. If you need adjustments or support at any stage, please let us know. Contact us at accesshelp@babcockinternational.com to discuss your needs and explore the options available. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone’s free to thrive. We are happy to talk about flexible working – please ask about alternative patterns of work at interview.
  
  

**Job Segment:** Computer Science, Construction, Quality Assurance, Systems Engineer, Nuclear Engineering, Technology, Engineering

Are you passionate about building digital solutions that make claims handling easier, faster and more reliable for our customers and want to be an important part of the digitalization journey at the Nordic region's largest insurance company?


**About the role**
------------------

In this role, you will help shape future solutions for motor claims handling. You will be part of a team responsible for creating a smooth customer journey from start to finish. You will work with modern technology in a team that values collaboration, learning and practical solutions that make a real difference.


We discuss architecture, good code and best practices together, and we support each other in finding solutions that work well in practice. Our technologies include .NET, hosting in Azure and Azure DevOps for CI/CD.


If has an overall ambition to be the Nordic and Baltic P\&C leader in leveraging AI capabilities and as developers, we use GitHub Copilot to faster deliver value for our customers.


You will have regular contact with business developers and users. Together, you will improve existing systems, develop new automation around claims and help create robust, efficient solutions for our customers.


**What you will do**
--------------------

* Develop high\-quality solutions based on If’s target architecture
* Contribute to how we deliver business value with quality code and best practices
* Understand existing systems and identify opportunities to improve and simplify them
* Communicate with colleagues, users and stakeholders

**We offer**
------------


Here are some of the benefits we offer at If:


* An inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome
* Good career and development opportunities at the largest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities and a professional work environment
* Opportunity to work in a hybrid workplace
* Health and wellbeing support, such as a wellness allowance and sports activities
* Good insurance benefits
* Lunch benefit
* High pension savings

**About the team**
------------------

You will join a Nordic team of around 10 colleagues with different backgrounds in business and IT. We are looking for someone who wants to be part of a team where people challenge each other, share knowledge and help each other succeed. We have an open culture where different opinions are respected. We also believe that enjoying working together helps us become better at what we do.


**Who are you?**
----------------

You have a strong interest in software development and good knowledge of C\#, .NET and agile ways of working. You are comfortable working with both backend and frontend development, especially for web solutions. You enjoy sharing your experience with the team and discussing solutions together with others.


You also have:


* At least 4 years of relevant work experience as a full\-stack developer
* Relevant university education or similar
* Experience with React or a similar web development framework
* Confidence communicating with colleagues and users in English. Swedish skills are considered a plus

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------


**Application deadline** : Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is 28th of September 2026\.
  

**To apply for the role** : Attach your CV and answer the questions in the recruitment system.
  

**Workplace** : Stockholm.
  

**Start date** : By agreement.


For more information, please contact Lars Lindow, Development Manager, lars.lindow@if.se


Read more about our Tech Community at If and how we work together to create “ tech that matters ”: www.if.se/tech


*Final candidates will undergo a background check before employment.*

We look forward to receiving your application!

**About the Opportunity**
=========================


Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 28 September 2026**Job Description**

  



**Title** AI Solutions Engineer

**Department** Asset Management Platforms

**Location**Dublin

**Reports To**Head of Portfolio Management Tooling, AMP

**Level** 6


We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together \- and supporting each other \- all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.


Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.


As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability\-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

**About your team**


Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Investment Management, Asset Management Operations and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enable investment professionals to make better investment decisions and improve client outcomes.


The Portfolio Management Tooling team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used by Portfolio Managers, Investment Directors, Quantitative Researchers and Investment Specialists across multiple investment capabilities, including Multi\-Asset, Systematic Investing, Fixed Income and Equities. Our platforms underpin critical investment processes including research, portfolio construction, analytics, order generation, execution management and investment risk.


As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI\-assisted development with robust engineering disciplines to improve productivity, quality and speed of delivery. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in helping engineering teams adopt AI\-enabled development practices safely, effectively and responsibly across Asset Management Platforms.

**About your role**  

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.


Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI\-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.


You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI\-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI\-assisted software engineering. This includes enabling engineering teams to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.


The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will champion modern software engineering practices, support architectural decision\-making, promote CI/CD and DevSecOps adoption, and help establish governance frameworks for the responsible use of AI within the software development lifecycle.


This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high\-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Engineering Enablement**

* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted software engineering practices across Asset Management Platforms.
* Evaluate emerging AI development tools and recommend practical use cases for engineering teams.
* Champion the effective use of Large Language Models to improve developer productivity and software quality.
* Develop reusable prompts, workflows, templates and engineering patterns for AI\-assisted software development.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI\-assisted development tools.
* Identify opportunities where AI can automate engineering activities including documentation, code generation, testing, code review, refactoring and technical analysis.
* Help establish engineering standards and governance for AI\-generated code.

**Software Engineering**

* Design and develop modern software solutions supporting Fidelity's investment management platforms.
* Promote engineering best practices across software design, development, testing and maintainability.
* Support engineering teams with complex technical design and implementation challenges.
* Encourage clean architecture, modular design and reusable software components.
* Participate in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering standards and practices.

**Engineering Excellence**

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Improve engineering productivity through automation and tooling.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote test automation and engineering quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Support engineering governance while encouraging innovation and experimentation.

**Architecture \& Governance**

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI\-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Contribute to engineering roadmaps and technology strategy.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI\-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge\-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.

**About you**


You are a hands\-on engineer with strong technical aptitude, curiosity and a passion for using AI to build useful software. You enjoy learning through experimentation, working with others and turning ideas into practical solutions in a fast\-moving environment.

**Experience**

* Practical experience using AI development tools to build or prototype solutions; this may come from professional experience, personal projects or independent experimentation.
* Good understanding of software engineering principles and experience working with code.
* Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor or similar.
* Understanding of prompt engineering and AI\-enabled software development workflows.
* Evidence of having built or delivered something practical, with an interest in progressing prototypes towards production.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the confidence to engage with business and technology colleagues.


Experience with some of the following would be useful; we do not expect candidates to have experience across all areas:

* Java, Python, C\#, TypeScript or similar languages
* AWS, Azure or GCP
* Docker and Kubernetes
* Git\-based development workflows
* REST APIs and event\-driven architectures
* Test automation and Infrastructure as Code
* Observability and monitoring tools


Experience in Asset Management, Investment Management or Financial Services is desirable but not essential.

**Personal Attributes**

* Curious, creative and enthusiastic about experimenting with AI.
* Strong aptitude and willingness to learn new technologies quickly.
* Pragmatic and comfortable learning from approaches that do not work.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across business and technology teams.
* Delivery\-focused and motivated by turning ideas into useful outcomes.
* Comfortable working with some ambiguity while seeking guidance when needed.

**Behavioural Expectations**

**Brave**

* Prioritise learning and momentum over defending legacy commitments.
* Remove blockers and reset priorities when outcomes are at risk.
* Role model stopping or reshaping work that no longer delivers value.

**Bold**

* Set clear, outcome\-led direction and make decisive trade\-offs.
* Simplify processes and governance where possible.
* Empower teams through effective decision making.

**Curious**

* Drive continuous prioritisation based on outcomes, data and evidence.
* Challenge assumptions and encourage innovative thinking.
* Use delivery metrics and business outcomes to inform decision making.

**Compassionate**

* Act as a visible advocate for client and business outcomes.
* Foster collaboration, trust and psychological safety.
* Balance delivery pace with sustainable ways of working.

**Feel rewarded**


For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

jobs.description:
**Join AutoProff – Help Shape the Future of Automotive Tech!**



We're looking for a **DevEx Engineer** to join our **Empower platform squad "Taycan"**. The squad is split between our HQ in Vejle and our Copenhagen office, so the role can be based in either location.



The Taycan squad helps engineers spend more time delivering product value and less time solving the same technical problems. We build shared capabilities that make the preferred engineering path easier to use.



As our new **DevEx Engineer**, you'll work on the shared tooling, libraries and development patterns used by engineering squads across AutoProff. From scaffolding and shared libraries to patterns such as Outbox, Sagas and messaging, you'll help make software development simpler and more consistent – so our product squads can spend less time solving the same technical problems and more time building great products.



You'll work closely with platform engineers, service owners and engineers across our product squads, building solutions that are used across the engineering organisation rather than within just one product area.



Help build shared capabilities and DevEx foundations that enable teams to work effectively with agentic AI.



Use agentic AI in your own DevEx work and share practical learning with engineering teams.



We foster a developer\-friendly culture with room to explore new technologies and ways of working. You'll have access to modern AI\-powered tools, join hackathons and take part in internal developer forums where we share ideas and discuss architecture, technology and engineering challenges.


**Let's dive into your key responsibilities, you will**


* Build and evolve shared libraries, scaffolding templates, and CI/CD tooling that remove recurring friction for product squads.
* Build paved paths for messaging patterns like Outbox and Sagas, observability, and rehydration/recovery tooling.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, and AWS infrastructure.
* Work with engineers across product squads to understand recurring friction and turn it into DevEx priorities.
* Help squads adopt platform practices that make service ownership, operation, and reuse easier.
* Support developers in adopting shared standards for tracing, service integration, AWS infrastructure, and secure, reliable defaults


**The need\-to\-have**

* Strong engineering experience in .NET / C\#.
* Proficiency in AWS services (e.g., ECS, Lambda, SQS, S3\) and infrastructure\-as\-code (CDK/Terraform).
* Familiarity with microservices, event\-driven architecture, and distributed\-systems patterns such as Outbox, Sagas, and CDC.
* Hands\-on experience building shared libraries, observability tooling, and reusable APIs.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to support squads, gather feedback, and drive adoption.


**The nice\-to\-have skills**


* Experience in platform engineering or developer enablement roles.
* Familiarity with internal documentation practices, onboarding tooling, and automated scaffolding.
* Hands\-on work with service event rehydration, incident recovery tooling, or metadata standards.
* Practical experience using LLMs, generative AI, or agentic AI in software development.


We're eager to hear from you! If this sounds like a great match and sparks your interest, don't wait, apply today!


**About AutoProff**



AutoProff was founded in 2013 by the experienced car dealer Jesper Ratza in Denmark. The aim was to digitalize B2B used car trading, helping car dealers increase sales and improve profits.



in August 2022, AutoScout24, the leading specialized pan\-European online car marketplace, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. The partnership has supported the rapid expansion of AutoProff's solutions across Europe and enables the creation of Europe's first fully integrated C2B\-B2B\-B2C dealing solution for used cars.



At AutoProff, we specialize in providing online B2B used\-car dealing solutions designed to improve the buying and selling experience for professional car dealers and their customers.



We are the emerging European leader with more than 150,000 B2B used cars on our online trading platforms annually.


With a focus on effective solutions, digitization and customer service, we are committed to being the home of B2B car dealing for European car dealers.

jobs.title: Associate AI Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
**Who Are We❓**  

*We Are Foodics!* a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.  

  

**The Job in a Nutshell**


You'll build the internal AI systems our engineers work inside every day: agents that generate and maintain tests, pipelines that triage failures before a human sees them, tooling that speeds up code review and debugging, and the evaluation infrastructure that makes our own AI features testable at all.


This is a builder's role. You'll write production code, own systems in CI, and be measured on whether engineers actually use what you ship.

**What Will You Do❓**


Test automation across the stack

* Backend: API and contract testing, service\-level and integration coverage, data setup that doesn't rot, and test design that survives a schema change.
* Frontend: web E2E and component\-level coverage with Playwright, visual and RTL regression, and suites fast enough to gate a merge rather than a nightly.
* Mobile: native and cross\-platform coverage with Appium or Maestro, device\-farm strategy, offline and sync behaviour, and the payment\-peripheral paths that only break on real hardware.
* The connective tissue: shared fixtures, environment and test\-data management, parallelisation, and CI pipelines where a red build means something.
* performance and load testing Experience.


The AI layer on top of it

* Test generation from specs, code, and production traffic — with the maintenance story solved, not just the first draft.
* Failure triage that classifies a red build before a human opens it: real bug, flake, environment, or test rot.
* Self\-healing locators and suite health tooling — flake detection, quarantine, coverage\-gap analysis.
* Evaluation infrastructure for AI features across our products: datasets, scoring, and regression detection when a prompt or model changes.
* Evaluation for our market specifically — Arabic and English behaviour, RTL interfaces, and region\-specific POS, tax, and payment rules. Correctness here is rarely a string match.


Agentic AI and orchestration

* Agentic AI that does real work in our pipelines: reads a diff, runs the relevant suite, reproduces a failure, proposes a fix, opens the PR.
* Agents that own a quality workflow end to end — exploratory testing against a running build, coverage\-gap hunting, release\-risk assessment — and know when to escalate to a human.
* Orchestration that holds up under load — multi\-step planning, tool use, retries, state and memory across steps, sandboxed execution, multi\-agent handoffs, and clean boundaries between agentic and deterministic steps.
* Integration with the stack we already have (CI, Jira, observability, MCP\-style tool interfaces) rather than a parallel system beside it.
* The judgement to know when a plain pipeline beats an agent, and to say so.


The technical ground
You should be current on how this work is actually done today, and able to argue about it rather than recite it:

* Test automation: framework design and layering, the test pyramid and where it stops being useful, flake economics, parallel execution, mobile and cross\-browser realities, CI/CD gating, Framework: Playwright, Appium, Maestro
* Agentic AI: orchestration and tool use, multi\-step planning, memory and state, sandboxed execution, multi\-agent patterns, MCP and similar tool\-integration standards, and the cost of each.
* Context engineering: retrieval strategy, chunking, reranking, caching, and managing long\-context behaviour — including where it degrades.
* Evaluation: offline and online evals, LLM\-as\-judge and its failure modes, human\-in\-the\-loop review, statistical significance on small samples, regression gates in CI.
* Reliability: structured output, guardrails, fallback and retry design, and handling non\-determinism in systems that must not flap.
* Operations: tracing and observability for LLM systems, prompt and version management, latency and cost budgeting, model routing, and when fine\-tuning or distillation beats a better prompt.

**What Are We Looking For❓**

* An engineer who ships production software, with recent hands\-on work on LLM\-backed systems that real users depend on.
* Strong Python; comfortable in at least one of .NET, Java, or TypeScript. Tested, maintained code — not notebooks.
* Real automation depth across more than one surface. You've owned a suite that gates releases on backend and on a UI — web or mobile — and you can explain how you kept it green without deleting the hard tests.
* Real experience building evaluation systems. You can explain how you knew your system was getting better, with numbers.
* Practical depth with the modern LLM toolkit — prompting, structured output, tool use, retrieval, agentic AI orchestration — and a clear sense of the trade\-offs.
* Credible testing fundamentals. You don't need a QA title, but test design, automation frameworks, and CI/CD shouldn't be new to you.
* A bias toward adoption. You measure your work by what other engineers use, not by what you demoed.

**What We Offer You❗**  

We believe you will love working at Foodics!

* We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in\-office, and hybrid work setups.
* We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares.
* We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper\-growth environment.
* Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry.
* We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

We are seeking a technically and commercially strong Senior Environmental Scientist/Consultant to join our Environment team in Dubai, with a core focus on leading Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA/ESIA) for fast\-paced, multidisciplinary design and infrastructure programs across the UAE and wider GCC. You will own end\-to\-end delivery of complex assessments, mentor junior staff, and support leadership through exemplary project execution, while actively contributing to work winning and client development. This role is specialist in EIA delivery rather than a single\-subject discipline, though a technical specialism (e.g., air quality, noise, hydrology, ecology, social) is welcome as a value\-add.

  

Our core values guide how we operate and what we aspire to: Safeguard, Innovate, Collaborate, Deliver, Sustain and Thrive. We expect you to embody these values in how you lead projects, support teams and engage clients. Our Sustainable Legacies strategy embeds sustainable development and resilience across our work, improves social outcomes, advances net\-zero objectives and enhances governance; you will help translate these pillars into practical outcomes on projects.

* **Leadership and Ownership**  

	+ Lead the planning, management and delivery of EIAs/ESIAs from screening and scoping through to approvals, conditions management and post\-consent obligations.

* **Technical Delivery (EIA/ESIA)**  

	+ Direct and author high\-quality, regulator\-ready EIA/ESIA chapters and integrated assessments, ensuring robust baseline definition, alternatives analysis, cumulative impact assessment and the mitigation hierarchy.

	+ Apply international lender standards (e.g., IFC Performance Standards/Equator Principles) where applicable and align them with UAE/GCC regulatory requirements.

* **Commercial and Work Winning**  

	+ Lead and contribute to proposals: technical approach, level\-of\-effort, pricing, risk registers, execution plans and differentiators; support pipeline development and client account growth.
	+ Build trusted relationships with clients; identify cross\-sell opportunities and strengthen repeat work through performance and insight\-led advice.
	+ Support bid governance and approvals; drive compliance with internal quality, risk and ethics standards.
* **Multidisciplinary Coordination**  

	+ Integrate EIA deliverables with planning, architecture, engineering and program management outputs; ensure design optimization reflects mitigation and sustainability outcomes.
	+ Champion practical, implementable mitigation and management measures aligned with design development, construction sequencing and operational realities.
* **Digital, Quality and Safety**  

	+ Utilize data, GIS and collaborative tools to streamline assessments and elevate quality; apply AECOM’s standards, templates and QA/QC processes.
	+ Promote a strong safety culture across office and field activities, aligning with AECOM’s Safeguard value and Code of Conduct. 1

 **Qualifications** **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science/Engineering or related field;
* 8–12\+ years of EIA/ESIA delivery experience in consultancy; UAE/GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrable track record leading EIAs for major urban development, transport, energy, water and/or industrial projects.
* Proven competence engaging with UAE regulators and navigating local permitting; experience with IFI standards (e.g., IFC PS) advantageous.
* Valid driving license; willingness to travel for site work as needed.

**Specific Skills Required**

* EIA/ESIA leadership: scoping, ToRs, baseline design, alternatives analysis, impact assessment, mitigation design and ESMP preparation.
* Regulatory and lenders: familiarity with UAE environmental approvals and experience aligning with IFC PS/Equator Principles where applicable.
* Commercial acumen: proposal leadership, pricing, risk/assumption management, governance compliance and negotiation with clients/subconsultants.
* Technical excellence: superior report writing, QA/QC, and integration of multi\-discipline inputs into clear, decision\-ready outputs.
* Tools and data: competent with GIS (ArcGIS/QGIS) and data management/visualization; statistical literacy beneficial.
* Specialism (bonus): added depth in one domain (e.g., air quality, noise, hydrology, ecology, social) to enhance EIA delivery and peer review.
* Sustainability integration: ability to translate AECOM’s Sustainable Legacies pillars into practical project measures and performance tracking.

  

**Additional Information** *At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.


AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**


You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. As a global organisation, Babcock provides countless opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career. To support your growth, we've introduced the Babcock Role Framework, which outlines roles, career pathways, and development opportunities. With every job mapped to these frameworks, you’ll have a transparent view of the steps needed to reach Senior Engineer and beyond.

We want you to feel supported, valued and excited about what’s ahead. That’s why we offer a comprehensive package designed to support your development, your wellbeing and your life outside of work too.

A minimum of 25 days of holiday plus bank holidays
  
Generous pension and employee share schemes
  
Flexible benefits, including cycle to work scheme, discounts
  
Wellbeing support, covering mental, physical, financial, and social wellbeing, with services like our Employee Assistance Programme, digital GP service, and health checks.
  
  

You’ll also have the chance to get involved in our STEM outreach activities and volunteering opportunities.

Many of our programmes are subject to Security Clearance and Trade Control restrictions which mean that your place of birth, nationality, citizenship, or residency you hold or have held may impact which programmes you are eligible for. For this programme, you must be able to achieve and maintain Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) and Security Check (SC) security clearance. For further details, visit GOV.UK and search ‘United Kingdom Security Vetting: clearance levels’.
  
  

Where will you be based?
  
  

Places on our Electrical Engineering programme for September 2027 are available in Rosyth, Scotland.

As a graduate, you could be involved in supporting the full lifecycle of naval vessels or helping deliver complex, large\-scale marine build projects.
  
  

Whether you're working on new\-build programmes or enhancing existing systems, your role will be vital in delivering dependable, mission\-ready solutions across the marine industry.
  
  

We offer agile working, giving you some flexibility, but you can expect to spend several days a week on\-site as part of your role and development. By your start date, you must be able to reliably commute to the site. This will normally require living within a reasonable commuting distance of Rosyth or relocating before you join us.
  
  

While you’ll join a specific business area and location, placements at different sites across the UK are possible. We encourage flexibility and openness to relocation throughout the programme and will consider your personal circumstances when arranging placements.
  
  

Application process and important information
  
  

Applications are reviewed in the order they are received, and if there’s a high level of interest in this programme, we may close applications earlier than advertised. To give yourself the best chance of being considered, we recommend submitting your application and completing any required online assessments as soon as possible.
  
  

Please apply to one programme only. If we receive more than one application from you, we’ll assess the first one submitted. If your chosen programme becomes oversubscribed, we may contact you to discuss other programmes you could be eligible for.
  
  

We're a Disability Confident Employer. If you need adjustments or support at any stage, please let us know. Contact us at accesshelp@babcockinternational.com to discuss your needs and explore the options available. We’re committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone’s free to thrive. We are happy to talk about flexible working – please ask about alternative patterns of work at interview.

**Who Are We❓**  

*We Are Foodics!* a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.  

  

**The Job in a Nutshell**


You'll build the internal AI systems our engineers work inside every day: agents that generate and maintain tests, pipelines that triage failures before a human sees them, tooling that speeds up code review and debugging, and the evaluation infrastructure that makes our own AI features testable at all.


This is a builder's role. You'll write production code, own systems in CI, and be measured on whether engineers actually use what you ship.

**What Will You Do❓**


Test automation across the stack

* Backend: API and contract testing, service\-level and integration coverage, data setup that doesn't rot, and test design that survives a schema change.
* Frontend: web E2E and component\-level coverage with Playwright, visual and RTL regression, and suites fast enough to gate a merge rather than a nightly.
* Mobile: native and cross\-platform coverage with Appium or Maestro, device\-farm strategy, offline and sync behaviour, and the payment\-peripheral paths that only break on real hardware.
* The connective tissue: shared fixtures, environment and test\-data management, parallelisation, and CI pipelines where a red build means something.
* performance and load testing Experience.


The AI layer on top of it

* Test generation from specs, code, and production traffic — with the maintenance story solved, not just the first draft.
* Failure triage that classifies a red build before a human opens it: real bug, flake, environment, or test rot.
* Self\-healing locators and suite health tooling — flake detection, quarantine, coverage\-gap analysis.
* Evaluation infrastructure for AI features across our products: datasets, scoring, and regression detection when a prompt or model changes.
* Evaluation for our market specifically — Arabic and English behaviour, RTL interfaces, and region\-specific POS, tax, and payment rules. Correctness here is rarely a string match.


Agentic AI and orchestration

* Agentic AI that does real work in our pipelines: reads a diff, runs the relevant suite, reproduces a failure, proposes a fix, opens the PR.
* Agents that own a quality workflow end to end — exploratory testing against a running build, coverage\-gap hunting, release\-risk assessment — and know when to escalate to a human.
* Orchestration that holds up under load — multi\-step planning, tool use, retries, state and memory across steps, sandboxed execution, multi\-agent handoffs, and clean boundaries between agentic and deterministic steps.
* Integration with the stack we already have (CI, Jira, observability, MCP\-style tool interfaces) rather than a parallel system beside it.
* The judgement to know when a plain pipeline beats an agent, and to say so.


The technical ground
You should be current on how this work is actually done today, and able to argue about it rather than recite it:

* Test automation: framework design and layering, the test pyramid and where it stops being useful, flake economics, parallel execution, mobile and cross\-browser realities, CI/CD gating, Framework: Playwright, Appium, Maestro
* Agentic AI: orchestration and tool use, multi\-step planning, memory and state, sandboxed execution, multi\-agent patterns, MCP and similar tool\-integration standards, and the cost of each.
* Context engineering: retrieval strategy, chunking, reranking, caching, and managing long\-context behaviour — including where it degrades.
* Evaluation: offline and online evals, LLM\-as\-judge and its failure modes, human\-in\-the\-loop review, statistical significance on small samples, regression gates in CI.
* Reliability: structured output, guardrails, fallback and retry design, and handling non\-determinism in systems that must not flap.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking a technically and commercially strong Senior Environmental Scientist/Consultant to join our Environment team in Dubai, with a core focus on leading Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA/ESIA) for fast\-paced, multidisciplinary design and infrastructure programs across the UAE and wider GCC. You will own end\-to\-end delivery of complex assessments, mentor junior staff, and support leadership through exemplary project execution, while actively contributing to work winning and client development. This role is specialist in EIA delivery rather than a single\-subject discipline, though a technical specialism (e.g., air quality, noise, hydrology, ecology, social) is welcome as a value\-add.

  

Our core values guide how we operate and what we aspire to: Safeguard, Innovate, Collaborate, Deliver, Sustain and Thrive. We expect you to embody these values in how you lead projects, support teams and engage clients. Our Sustainable Legacies strategy embeds sustainable development and resilience across our work, improves social outcomes, advances net\-zero objectives and enhances governance; you will help translate these pillars into practical outcomes on projects.

 **Duties \& Responsibilities**

* **Leadership and Ownership**  

	+ Lead the planning, management and delivery of EIAs/ESIAs from screening and scoping through to approvals, conditions management and post\-consent obligations.
	+ Take full ownership of scope, schedule, budget, risks and quality; drive decisive issue resolution and proactive change control.
	+ Mentor, coach and quality\-review the work of junior and mid\-level practitioners; foster a culture of learning and accountability.
* **Technical Delivery (EIA/ESIA)**  

	+ Direct and author high\-quality, regulator\-ready EIA/ESIA chapters and integrated assessments, ensuring robust baseline definition, alternatives analysis, cumulative impact assessment and the mitigation hierarchy.
	+ Coordinate inputs from discipline SMEs (e.g., air, noise, hydrology, biodiversity, social) and integrate findings into a coherent assessment narrative and Environmental \& Social Management Plans (ESMPs).
	+ Apply international lender standards (e.g., IFC Performance Standards/Equator Principles) where applicable and align them with UAE/GCC regulatory requirements.
* **Regulatory and Stakeholder Interface**  

	+ Engage with UAE federal and emirate regulators (e.g., MoCCAE, Dubai Municipality) and relevant authorities in free zones as applicable; manage consultations and respond to formal feedback.
	+ Lead structured stakeholder engagement processes, ensuring documentation of issues, responses and commitments in line with project governance.
* **Commercial and Work Winning**  

	+ Lead and contribute to proposals: technical approach, level\-of\-effort, pricing, risk registers, execution plans and differentiators; support pipeline development and client account growth.
	+ Build trusted relationships with clients; identify cross\-sell opportunities and strengthen repeat work through performance and insight\-led advice.
	+ Support bid governance and approvals; drive compliance with internal quality, risk and ethics standards.
* **Multidisciplinary Coordination**  

	+ Integrate EIA deliverables with planning, architecture, engineering and program management outputs; ensure design optimization reflects mitigation and sustainability outcomes.
	+ Champion practical, implementable mitigation and management measures aligned with design development, construction sequencing and operational realities.
* **Digital, Quality and Safety**  

	+ Utilize data, GIS and collaborative tools to streamline assessments and elevate quality; apply AECOM’s standards, templates and QA/QC processes.
	+ Promote a strong safety culture across office and field activities, aligning with AECOM’s Safeguard value and Code of Conduct. 1

 **Qualifications** **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science/Engineering or related field;
* 8–12\+ years of EIA/ESIA delivery experience in consultancy; UAE/GCC experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrable track record leading EIAs for major urban development, transport, energy, water and/or industrial projects.
* Proven competence engaging with UAE regulators and navigating local permitting; experience with IFI standards (e.g., IFC PS) advantageous.
* Valid driving license; willingness to travel for site work as needed.

**Specific Skills Required**

* EIA/ESIA leadership: scoping, ToRs, baseline design, alternatives analysis, impact assessment, mitigation design and ESMP preparation.
* Regulatory and lenders: familiarity with UAE environmental approvals and experience aligning with IFC PS/Equator Principles where applicable.
* Commercial acumen: proposal leadership, pricing, risk/assumption management, governance compliance and negotiation with clients/subconsultants.
* Technical excellence: superior report writing, QA/QC, and integration of multi\-discipline inputs into clear, decision\-ready outputs.
* Tools and data: competent with GIS (ArcGIS/QGIS) and data management/visualization; statistical literacy beneficial.
* Specialism (bonus): added depth in one domain (e.g., air quality, noise, hydrology, ecology, social) to enhance EIA delivery and peer review.
* Sustainability integration: ability to translate AECOM’s Sustainable Legacies pillars into practical project measures and performance tracking.
